A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the linear momentum flux has been calculated up to 3PN accuracy for a binary system composed by two compact objects.
we have provided an analytical formula, accurate up to 2.5 post-Newtonian order for the linear momentum radiated from a compact binary system in radial infall, in terms of its orbital parameters.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the recoil velocity can be estimated to within 10% by using only the 1.5PN formula, and to within 1% by using the 2PN formula.
